attributes.title: 2027 NCCA Annual Conference: Strengthening the Core to Scale the Future
attributes.venue: Hotel Ballast, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
attributes.summary:
Plan ahead, because NCCA does not take registration on site: online sign-up closes February 13, 2027. Pre-conference sessions are sold separately, and the fee table separates new professionals and graduate students from full professionals, so check which line you qualify for.

The association's site offers a CE route for events, but the 2027 hour total is not published yet. Early-bird registration ends November 30, 2026, or when sold out; the page lists one set of rates (as of June 1, 2026) and no later price, so confirm the amount at checkout.
